channel.title: JKLab
channel.description: JKLab develops BerEditor, CertMan, and CryptokiMan for analysis of PKI technology.

item.title: Basic Encoding Rule
item.description: Learn ASN.1 BER encoding with TLV, tags, lengths, data types, OIDs, and practical hexadecimal examples.

item.title: Download
item.description: Download BerEditor for Windows, macOS, or Linux to view and edit ASN.1 BER/DER data and KMIP TTLV messages.

item.title: ASN.1 BER vs DER
item.description: Compare ASN.1 BER and DER encoding rules with hexadecimal examples, including lengths, Boolean values, strings, certificates, and signatures.

item.title: Home
item.description: Explore JKLab’s PKI software and guides, including BerEditor, CertMan, CryptokiMan, digital certificates, and public key infrastructure.

item.title: About me
item.description: Meet JayKim, the developer of JKLab’s PKI and cryptography tools, and find contact and support information.

item.title: Tools
item.description: Explore JKLab tools for ASN.1 data, X.509 certificates, and PKCS#11 hardware security modules.

item.title: Release
item.description: Review BerEditor release notes, feature updates, and fixes for the ASN.1 BER/DER and KMIP tool.

item.title: JKLab Blog
item.description: Read updates and articles from JKLab on PKI, cryptography, and software tools.

item.title: Download
item.description: Download CertMan for Windows, macOS, or Linux to manage X.509 certificates, key pairs, CSRs, and CRLs.

item.title: Release
item.description: Review CertMan release notes, feature updates, and fixes for the X.509 certificate and CRL manager.

item.title: Download
item.description: Download CryptokiMan for Windows, macOS, or Linux to manage and test PKCS#11 Cryptoki modules.

item.title: Release
item.description: Review CryptokiMan release notes, feature updates, and fixes for the PKCS#11 Cryptoki manager.

item.title: PKI Concept
item.description: Learn the basics of public key infrastructure, including certificate authorities, registration authorities, certificates, and revocation.

item.title: Digital Signatures and Certificates
item.description: Understand digital signatures, certificates, certificate authorities, and PKI through a plain-language analogy.

item.title: PrivateKey, PublicKey, Certificate
item.description: Learn how private keys, public keys, and certificates work together to create and verify digital signatures.

item.title: Applying the license
item.description: Learn how to request and apply a free 60-day license for BerEditor, CertMan, and CryptokiMan.
